question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A large bundle bound for storage or transport
solution:
The correct answer is **"Bale"** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** Here let's learn the word with the help of an example:

__
 
• **Bale -** A bale of hay/cloth/paper/cotton

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Let's see some other word meanings:

 
• **Antagonist -** one that contends with or opposes another 
 
• **Belligerent -** unfriendly and aggressive
 
• **Apiary - **a place where bees are kept
